questions.question: When you start `claude` in a folder, what can it read without asking?
options: Nothing, every read needs a yes
Files in that folder and below
questions.explanation: The folder you start in is Claude's world. Reading inside it is free; writes and commands ask first.

questions.question: You said yes 'once' to creating a file. Claude wants to edit it again. What happens?
questions.explanation: 'Once' is one permission. 'Always allow' (for this folder) is what makes it quiet.

questions.question: After /clear, you ask 'what did we write?'. Claude...
options: Has no idea: the context is empty
questions.explanation: Context is what was read in this session. /clear empties it. CLAUDE.md (phase 01) is what survives.

questions.question: What does the course log when you work?
options: Session start/end, phases, check results, minutes
questions.explanation: Timestamps, phase ids, check results, quiz scores, minutes. Never prompts, transcripts or files. See progress/SCHEMA.md.
